function drawParticles(s, dt, stage, jagAmp): void

Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn/particles.ts:114

Advances + draws particles. Burn embers flicker upward on buoyancy and flecks tumble down; rebuild deposits (dir −1) fall under gravity from the empty zone above each letter and die the moment they reach the climbing front — the landing reads as the glyph re-inking itself.

Parameters

s

BurnSession

The live session — mutates s.particles, paints on s.ctx.

dt

number

Seconds since the last frame.

stage
